sinopsis.es: Un cuerpo intenta reconocerse a través de aquello que le falta. Mientras mide sus contornos, se fragmenta y vuelve a componerse, la ausencia de un caballo abre una pregunta sobre el deseo, la memoria y la identidad.
sinopsis.en: Trying to understand what a body without a horse is by seeing what it’s capable of, the film shows a very present absence. With minimalist and handcrafted visuals, we follow the body as it performs a series of actions, yet remaining horseless. Playing with choreographic movements, language and its metaphors, the film explores how absence can shape the way we move, desire, forget and remember.
